header.function_name: X1 Crossdock Master Setting - Part List

objective: To register crossdock candidate parts (Part No, Min MAD, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Effective Start Date).
To search and display registered crossdock parts with their status, capacity and mapping completeness.
To change part data and part status (Candidate / Active / Inactive) of a registered part.
To display the change history of a part.
To export the Part List to Excel and upload part settings from Excel (Add and Edit).
This sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a Procurement account; users with a D/S account open the Mapping per Destination sub-menu instead.

buttons.name: Add Part
buttons.function: Open the "Add Part Candidate Crossdock" modal (Add Mode), ready to register a new part.

buttons.name: Upload Excel
buttons.function: Open the "Upload Excel - part settings" modal (Upload Mode).

buttons.name: Export Excel
buttons.function: Download the Part List as .xlsx: sheet "Part List" (active filter) and sheet "Upload" (base file for Edit uploads).

buttons.name: Reset
buttons.function: Clear criteria and reset the screen to its initial value.

buttons.name: Search
buttons.function: To retrieve records according to the specified criteria. The criteria are applied only when [Search] is clicked (or Enter is pressed in a text box); Sort by is applied at once.

buttons.name: Part Number link / Edit

buttons.name: History
buttons.function: Open the "History setting" modal of the selected part.

buttons.name: Close

buttons.name: Validate file

items: The sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a Procurement account.
Search criteria: 'Part Number' and 'Part Name' blank, 'Status' = All, 'Sort by' = Newer to Older.
Retrieve all parts of TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and display them sorted by CHANGED_DT descending, 25 rows per page, page 1.
If no part is registered at all, hide the table and display message no. 2 with [Upload Excel] and [Add one part].
The criteria are applied when the user clicks [Search] (or presses Enter in 'Part Number' / 'Part Name'); changing a criterion alone does not change the list. 'Sort by' is applied at once.
'Part Number' and 'Part Name' match by 'contains', case-insensitive; 'Status' matches exactly. All criteria are combined with AND.
Clicking [Search] or changing 'Sort by' or 'Rows per page' returns the list to page 1.
If no row matches, hide the table and paging and display message no. 1 with [Reset filter].
Counter 'N parts · M incomplete mappings' is counted over the whole filtered result, not only the current page.

Incomplete mapping: the part has no destination in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST, or the sum of destination CASE_DAY differs from MAX_CASE_DAY. Mark the row with a blue bar and count it in 'M incomplete mappings'.
Total Pcs/Day = Pcs/Case x Max Case/Day.
Open the 'Add Part Candidate Crossdock' modal. 'Status' = Candidate and locked (a new part is always Candidate); 'Effective Start Date' = system date + 1 day, minimum today.
'Part No' lists parts of TB_M_PART_MASTER that are not yet registered in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE, so can not register part into Crossdock master
Selecting a Part No autofills 'Part Name'. 'Max Case/Day' is locked until 'Pcs/Case' is filled.

[Save] is enabled only when Part No, Min MAD (whole number, 0 or more), Pcs/Case > 0 and Max Case/Day > 0 are filled; otherwise its tooltip shows message no. 5, 15, 6 or 7 for the first missing item. Effective Start Date
If the Part No was registered by another user in the meantime, display message no. 3. Stop.
Insert the part into TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE with PART_STATUS = Candidate and SYNC_STATUS = 0 (No Sync) (refer Data Edit Mapping).
Insert the change history when any register or update data in Part List
Close the modal, reset the Part Number / Part Name / Status filters, sort Newer to Older and display message no. 9. The new part is shown at the top.

operation.text: User clicks [Cancel] or the X icon: close the modal without saving.
User clicks the 'Part Number' link or [Edit] on a row.

items: Open the 'Edit part data' modal with the saved values. 'Part No' is locked; 'Status' can be Candidate / Active / Inactive.
'Effective Start Date' is editable only while the saved status is Candidate (minimum today); otherwise locked with message no. 10 as tooltip.
'Min MAD' (mandatory, whole number 0 or more), 'Pcs/Case' and 'Max Case/Day' can be changed; 'Total Pcs/Day' is recalculated.

Max Case/Day can not be less than the total Case/Day already mapped to destinations in the ongoing period (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST); otherwise the field is marked red, message no. 14 is shown below Pcs/Case & Max Case/Day and [Save] is disabled. The user must first reduce the mapping in Mapping per Destination (same rule as upload check 9).
If the record was changed by another user after it was opened, display message no. 4. Stop.
Check Max Case/Day against the mapped total of the ongoing period again on the server; if it is below, display message no. 14. Stop.
Update TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and set SYNC_STATUS = 0 (No Sync), CHANGED_BY and CHANGED_DT. Every Save returns the part to No Sync so the D/S user synchronises it again.
Insert the change history when any register or update in Part List
Close the modal, move the part to the top of the list and display message no. 9.
History retrieved from inserted data when user add/modify part list data
User clicks the clock icon on a row: open 'History setting' with the change timeline of the part, newest first.
Each event shows the title, date-time, field name, old value (struck through) → new value and user.

History is read from TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE, which records every change of the part: Add / Edit by screen, Upload, mapping changes (add, change or remove a destination) and Sync results. A part without history shows message no. 12.

operation.text: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE (proposed) - one record per changed field, insert only:

rows: Calculation period YYYYMM for MAPPING / SYNC; NULL for ADD / EDIT (Part List has no period)
Upload of the change (Log); NULL when not from an upload
Destination code (7 digits) for MAPPING; NULL for other events
Changed field: PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, MIN_MAD, PART_STATUS, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, CASE_DAY, SYNC_STATUS
Value before the change; NULL for ADD or an added destination
Value after the change; NULL for a removed destination
Free text, e.g. SYNC_MESSAGE of a Failed sync
User who made the change (RPA user ID for SYNC)
Date and time of the change

operation.text: Events: ADD / EDIT (source SCREEN or UPLOAD, PERIOD NULL), MAPPING (source SCREEN or UPLOAD, PERIOD and DEST_CODE filled, FIELD_NAME CASE_DAY), SYNC (source RPA, FIELD_NAME SYNC_STATUS, REMARK = SYNC_MESSAGE).
Proposed retention: 24 months online by CREATED_DT; a monthly housekeeping job deletes older records (period configurable in system master). To be confirmed.

items: User clicks [Upload Excel]: open the modal with the template columns, the rules and the file area (.xlsx, max 5 MB, max 5,000 rows).
Edit rows use sheet 'Upload' of the Part List Export Excel as base file (pre-filled with flag E).
Status rule: a Candidate part's status cannot be changed by upload; Active <-> Inactive can be changed; no part can be changed to Candidate.

User clicks [Validate file] (save button of the upload): the file is passed to the upload batch; validation, saving (all-or-nothing) and logging follow UISS-Batch "Crossdock Master Setting - Part List Upload".
When the upload is completed, close the modal and display message no. 11. When it is rejected, show the batch result (error list) - refer UISS-Batch.
Changed parts show Sync Status No Sync.
User clicks [Export Excel]: download Crossdock_Part_List_YYYYMMDD.xlsx.

Sheet 'Part List': rows of the active filter and sort (all pages) with Part Number, Part Name, Min MAD, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Total Pcs/Day, Status, Effective Start Date, Last Update. Information only.
Sheet 'Upload': every registered part with part_no, min_mad, pcs_case, max_case_day, status, flag_add_edit = E, effective_start_date (DD-Mon-YYYY). Base file for Edit uploads.
If the file cannot be created, display message no. 13.

rows: Newly registered part without MAD history. Initial status of every new part; cannot be chosen when adding.
Active part. Only Active parts can be mapped in the Mapping per Destination sub-menu.
Inactive part. Not mapped in the Mapping per Destination sub-menu.
Not sent yet, or changed since the last synchronisation. Set on every Save.
[Sync] clicked in Mapping per Destination; waiting for the RPA to send it to the global system.
The RPA sent Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day and the destination mapping of the ongoing period.
The RPA could not send the part (reason in SYNC_MESSAGE); retried by the next [Sync].

operation.text: Only Active parts are synchronised. A Save while the part is Waiting returns it to No Sync, so the RPA result of the old data is not kept as Success.
